title: filter_properties is O(n*m): Vec::contains for each property key
description: email.rs:543-547 — for each key in the object, properties.contains(k) does a linear scan of the properties Vec. With P properties and K object keys: O(P*K) per email. For Email/get with 26 properties and 100 emails, that's 2600 comparisons per call. Fix: convert properties slice to a HashSet before iterating the map.
